Deterministic generation enables collision resistance (2^48 combinations) with reproducibility
Auto-discovery must scan recursively up to 10 levels to handle nested hub structures
Registry at .WAI-registry/spokes.json enables hub-level cross-project validation
File validator pattern enables middleware detection of cross-project file conflicts
Automatic discovery is THE critical feature - WAI must be seen and loaded without manual prompting
Session start briefing creates immediate continuity and confirms WAI loaded correctly
Corrected metaphor: Hub=memory+registry, Spoke-Project=project memory, Wheels=Hub+all Spokes together
The wheel metaphor resonates - hub (memory), spokes (capabilities), wheel (project)
